authorityAndLimitations: All outputs remain RESEARCH_ONLY or MODEL_DERIVED_SIMULATION/scenario diagnostics.
No canonical shipping provider registration or authority promotion is performed.
Hill, AMD and radial-overlap screens are not N-body, resonance, secular-chaos or Lagrange-stability truth.
MIST support is a versioned interpolation contract only; no grid was embedded or silently interpolated.
Multiplicity requires a named population and preserves joint period/q/e coupling and selection caveats.
Rocky mass-radius does not uniquely infer composition and returns UNSUPPORTED outside 1-8 Earth masses and CMF 0-0.4.
Water-rich scenarios require high-pressure EOS; H/He scenarios require an evolution grid and explicit age/irradiation/envelope inputs.
Atmospheric escape classification does not authorize a universal rate model; energy-limited rates remain conditional on applicability inputs.
Geodynamics output does not assert plate tectonics or deterministic tectonic history.
Grey atmosphere and 0-D EBM do not assert weather, GCM-equivalent local climate or habitability.
Impact loss is a bounded paper-specific scenario, not universal history reconstruction.
dependencyBlockers: A full Laskar-Petit/Petit-Laskar-Boue critical AMD/Hill threshold implementation still requires an independently validated derivation and adversarial fixtures before promotion.

Conditional multiplicity priors still require a population-conditioned empirical table and explicit selection-function provenance.
Water-rich/high-pressure EOS and sub-Neptune evolution tables are not embedded.
1-D latitudinal EBM, transient heat-capacity integration, physical erosion transport and coupled long-term planetary evolution remain beyond this checkpoint.
